blocks.text: Real-world analogue: A monumental observatory, sea horizon framed by stone, ancient dolmen, sealed transit terminal, reflecting monument, and an enormous door whose other side is suggested by light rather than visible architecture.
World relation: Open World contact and Pilgrim World threshold experience. Continuity establishes enough synchronization for a relationship to persist without transferring ownership of the person.
Connection to newer locations: The Gate connects to Mirror-Save Shore, Archipelago of Borrowed Horizons, Inland Sea of Doors, Plain of Missing Distance, and Skyfold Boundary.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: The player is not entering as a conqueror or returning god. The Gate is a translation surface through which two histories can begin changing one another.
